commands: '=== SNI=s6.eightfoldway.com (CloudFront always uses this), varying unmatched Host across zones ==='
foreach ($h in $hosts) { $code = curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" --resolve s6.eightfoldway.com:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Host: $h" https://s6.eightfoldway.com/ ; "  Host=$h -> http=$code" }
'=== sanity: a REAL matched host still serves (not swallowed) ==='
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "  Host=mn.hb101.org -> http=%{http_code}`n" --resolve s6.eightfoldway.com:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Host: mn.hb101.org" https://s6.eightfoldway.com/
'=== is there ANY site with a blank-hostheader (true catch-all) binding? ==='

Import-Module WebAdministration; $blank=@(); Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $s=$_; $s.Bindings.Collection | ForEach-Object { if ($_.bindingInformation -match '^\*?:(80|443):$') { $blank += "$($s.Name) | $($_.bindingInformation)" } } }; if ($blank) { 'BLANK-HOST bindings:'; $blank } else { 'no blank-host bindings (404 is http.sys no-match default)' }
